auditor: VoyPlan Autonomous AI Product Engineering Organization (Council & R&D)

stack.frontend: Flutter Multi-Platform (Web, Android, iOS) + Vanilla HTML Landing

PRODUCT_GAPS.impact: Over 68% of travel itineraries are group trips, but trips are currently single-owner bound in Supabase schema without shared editing or voting.
PRODUCT_GAPS.remediation: Implement trip_collaborators table with role-based WebSocket sync.

PRODUCT_GAPS.gap: No Highway EV Charging / Corridor Elevation Awareness
PRODUCT_GAPS.impact: EV users cannot plan charging stops based on battery capacity or highway station reliability.
PRODUCT_GAPS.remediation: Integrate verified Indian fast-charging stations and elevation consumption models.

PRODUCT_GAPS.impact: Loss of mobile connectivity in Western Ghats, Spiti, or Nilgiris leaves travelers without turn-by-turn guidance.
PRODUCT_GAPS.remediation: Provide 1-click GPX/KML route export and printable emergency PDF.

BUG_RISKS.risk: Hallucinatory Metropolitan Locations in Itinerary Planner
BUG_RISKS.impact: Selecting Destination: Tirumala previously pulled in Bengaluru/Mysuru/Chennai.
BUG_RISKS.remediation: Enforced deterministic Haversine distance ceiling (<75km) and forbidden city cluster filters in geminiValidatorService.js. Verified with 8/8 regression tests.

BUG_RISKS.impact: External router router.project-osrm.org can rate-limit or fail during network drops.
BUG_RISKS.remediation: Add local SQLite/memory geometry caching and automated fallback to Mapbox Directions API.

TECHNICAL_DEBT.description: backend/src/routes/ai.js contains >1200 lines handling multiple route endpoints, prompt definitions, and validation logic.
TECHNICAL_DEBT.remediation: Extract prompt templates into src/prompts/ and validator services into modular service handlers.

TECHNICAL_DEBT.description: Large uncompressed audio files in mobile/assets/audio/ inflate APK/IPA download sizes.
TECHNICAL_DEBT.remediation: Compress MP3 audio assets with ffmpeg to reduce bundle by ~12 MB.

UX_OPPORTUNITIES.opportunity: Dynamic Island / Android Car App Live Route Status
UX_OPPORTUNITIES.impact: Provides glanceable ETA, next turn direction, and weather alerts while driving without unlocking the phone.
Allows travelers to effortlessly swap Day 1 and Day 2 stops or re-sequence places directly on the map polyline.

AI_OPPORTUNITIES.impact: Allows travelers to upload an Instagram screenshot or photo of a travel spot, extracting coordinates and automatically inserting it into their route.
Dynamically shifts temple or viewpoint visit timings to sunrise/sunset or avoids known peak temple darshan queue hours.

MAP_OPPORTUNITIES.impact: Renders stunning 3D mountain topography for ghat road trips (Western Ghats, Himalayas) directly in WebGL and Flutter.
Visualizes live rain and fog polygons directly over the highway route polyline.

WEB_OPPORTUNITIES.impact: Renders complex multi-thousand point route polylines at smooth 60 FPS on lower-end laptops.
Generates a clean, monochrome printable PDF travel packet with emergency contacts and offline maps.

MOBILE_OPPORTUNITIES.opportunity: Deep Android Auto & Apple CarPlay Route Projection
MOBILE_OPPORTUNITIES.impact: Projects VoyPlan navigation and car mode guidance directly to vehicle head unit infotainment displays.
Alerts the traveler via TTS voice when approaching a planned scenic viewpoint or food stop.

SECURITY_OPPORTUNITIES.impact: Ensures traveler GPS lat/lng are strictly used for in-memory routing and never stored in persistent database logs.
Instantly resolves moderate/high package advisories in backend/package.json.

PERFORMANCE_OPPORTUNITIES.impact: Caches identical origin-destination routing queries to achieve <5ms response latency.

FEATURE_OPPORTUNITIES.title: Live Weather Hazards & Monsoon Flood Warnings Along Route
Smart EV Charging & Fuel Optimization Along Highway Corridor
Real-Time Collaborative Trip Planning with Live Presence
Offline Route & Waypoint Export to GPX, KML & PDF Guide
